assets.caption: FIGURE 10 EFFECT OF A VERTICAL SIDE ARM ON GAS LIQUID SPLITTING
assets.notes: Scatter plot showing fraction of liquid taken off (y-axis, 0-1) vs fraction of gas taken off (x-axis, 0-1) for air/water experiment with pipe diameter 0.038 m and 0.025 m side arm. Two data series: asterisks for vertically upward side arm, plus signs for vertically upward side arm with bend at end of main pipe.
